oracles.tool: plan_rows_oracle.py: a line parser of docs/plans/README.md's row grammar

notes: oracle tiers and families (wave fx item fmt, calibration/oracles/fathom-plan-rows): sym_* (L1: a task per row that carries an id), ref_* (L2: a row to each row of the same plan its needs names) and xref_* (L3: a row to the row of another plan that needs: <plan>.md#ID names) are tier C. The oracle is plan_rows_oracle.py, a line parser of docs/plans/README.md's row grammar written without verify.ParseMarkdownPlan or gen-plan-cue (the product's extractor reuses that parser; the oracle shares none of its code). No tool reads the grammar for it, so every metric caps at good (design §1.3). Lines come from the same parser (range_agreement 1 over 2,706 rows)

structure is graded beside the metrics, tier A and not one of them: cue vet -d '#Plan' schema/plan/schema.cue over the parser's JSON for each plan passes on 89 of 90 plans; bench-pyramid.md fails because #Expect.oracle admits only lexical while the grammar and the gate accept ledger (O504)

the subject is this repository's own 90 plans (README.md is no plan: it holds no row with an id; docs/plans/archive/ is out of the glob); the vendored agentic-kit mirror carries no docs/plans, so there is no second subject. 2,706 rows, 2,587 same-plan needs and 79 cross-plan needs, all found and none extra

L3 here is the plan-to-plan joins only: the harness scores references between files it measures, so a row's symbol, reachable_from and package anchors to code files are no metric of this reading (O503). Measured beside it, off the harness, against universal-ctags 6.2.1 (tier B, which defines the file of each anchor's name): the 2,571 plan-to-code edges a fresh scratch ingest of fathom at the measuring commit stores all name a file ctags attests (precision 1), and 2,541 of the 2,543 anchors ctags resolves to one file are found (recall .9992); the two missed are Drop and Trim in internal/memo, each both a function and a method of that package, which the gate's own package: rule keeps ambiguous. of the 2,924 symbol and reachable_from anchors at that commit, 347 name no definition ctags reads, which no edge claims
per-file times exclude the one-time grammar compile (an untimed warm-up extraction precedes timing)
